latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the auto-updater skill.
- Sets up a daily cron job to automatically update Clawdbot and all installed skills.
- Sends a summary message to the user after updates are applied.
- Includes instructions for setup, configuration, manual commands, troubleshooting, and disabling auto-updates.
